tables.name: The Sunken Keep
tables.pitch: Level-3 dungeon crawl beneath a drowned chapel. Pregens provided.

tables.name: Duskvol Heist
tables.pitch: One score, one crew, one very angry Spirit Warden.

tables.name: Goblin Market
tables.pitch: Low-level, high-chaos. Bring a goblin voice.

tables.name: Dead Planet
tables.pitch: Sci-fi horror on a derelict. You will not all make it.

tables.name: Dragon Heist, Ch. 1
tables.pitch: Waterdeep intro chapter, level 1, new players welcome.

tables.name: Strahd Must Die Tonight
tables.pitch: Level-10 one-shot: storm Ravenloft in four hours.

tables.name: Summer of '87
tables.pitch: Small-town weirdness, no prep needed, rules taught at the table.

tables.name: The Long Night
tables.pitch: Survival horror at level 5. Lights off, candles on.

tables.name: Midnight Munchkin
tables.pitch: Backstabbing card game for the sleepless. Drop in, drop out.

tables.name: Graveyard Shift
tables.pitch: Investigators at 1 AM. Sanity not guaranteed.

tables.name: Dawn Patrol
tables.pitch: Level-2 skirmish for early risers and never-sleepers.

tables.name: Breakfast Brawl
tables.pitch: Arena one-shot with pancakes. Pregens provided.

events.text: Welcome to Lanternlight! A full day of games, snacks, and new friends.
For everyone finding their first adventuring party!
Dinner is ready! Visit the buffet and grab a seat.
The late-night games are starting. Welcome, night owls!
A toast to our overnight adventurers and tireless game masters!
Breakfast is served. Coffee and pancakes for the dawn crew!
Thank you for a wonderful marathon. Safe travels home!
